home.ctaText: Since 2011 we have kept 700+ elevators running safely across Georgia. Our qualified technicians are on call around the clock.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Elevator experts serving Georgia since 2011
about.historyText: Founded in 2011 in Tbilisi, Vertical Technology has grown into one of Georgia's trusted elevator companies. Today we install, maintain and repair more than 700 elevators across the country - from residential blocks to hospitals and commercial centers.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.text: Every installation and repair follows strict safety standards and a full post-work inspection.

availability.title: 24/7 availability
availability.text: Zone-based technicians and a stocked spare-parts warehouse mean fast response, day or night.

team.title: Qualified team
team.text: Certified technicians with years of field experience on all major elevator brands.

about.partnersText: We install and service equipment from leading world manufacturers.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Installation, maintenance and repair - one partner for the full elevator lifecycle

installation.title: Installation
installation.subtitle: New elevators, tailored to your building
installation.text: From shaft consulting to final handover, we handle the full installation: design selection, economy or premium configuration, and custom orders for unusual shafts.

service.title: Service
service.subtitle: Maintenance that never sleeps
service.text: Our zone-based technician system keeps a specialist close to your building. Scheduled maintenance, a stocked spare-parts warehouse and emergency response keep your elevator running safely around the clock.

repair.title: Repair
repair.subtitle: From inspection to modernization
repair.text: We start every repair with an inspection and a written defect report. From small adjustments to full modernization, we bring old elevators back to safe, smooth operation.
